name: essay
description: Long-form argumentative prose written to be read: posts, essays, opinion pieces.
notes: The register with the least tolerance for flat rhythm. An essay that varies
little in sentence length reads as generated even when every word is fine,
so cv_len is tight here and loose in `technical`.
Surveying without committing is itself a signal in this register — the
prose-substance-critic looks for it, but the deterministic pass cannot.
